name: IM-2 Athena (Mons Mouton area)

outcomeDetail.summary: Landed on its side in a shadowed crater about 20 m across, after 'noisy' laser-altimeter data may have contributed. With the Sun's direction, panel orientation and extreme cold in the crater, it could not recharge; operations ended in under 13 hours.

sources.label: NASA, receives some data before Intuitive Machines ends lunar mission
SpaceNews, IM-2 lunar lander mission ends

blurb: Came down in a shadowed crater and lost power within hours: where you end up decides whether you get power.
